verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 113.9 (-1.4% in a day) and momentum is 42: prices are falling. 84s cost 850, 85s 2,300 and 86s 4,400. The weekend is ending, and prices usually ease into Monday.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-01T20:18:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Sveindís Jane Jónsdóttir 86 Ultimate Scream after its 58% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 45,750 coins. Now 38,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 58.4% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 4 so far, averaging +2.8% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Weekend is ending: wait before buying
moves.detail: Prices usually ease as the weekend ends and players sell their squads. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-11-05T07:59:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 850 (1.02 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,300 (1.10 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,400 (1.07 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,500 (1.18 coins per Item Score point), 88s 11,750 (1.42 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 86s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Unai Núñez and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Unai Núñez 75 Rare -53.7%; Laura Pérez 85 Ultimate Scream -42.7%; Eric García 85 Rare -40.2%; Sveindís Jane Jónsdóttir 86 Ultimate Scream -38.7%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
